messages:
maria: Heads up: deploy-bot flagged a mismatch on the py/ts SDK publish (checksum != dist-tag). Holding all canaries. @devon can you confirm?
release-bot: publish failed: signature_verification_error for package redwood-sdk-py v2.3.1 — artifacts quarantined.
devon: seeing the same in CI artifacts. sdist checksum doesn't match the GH release assets. don't promote to dist-tag or shadow route.
kevin: rolling back any automated tag promotion now. running: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk@latest` and preparing `twine delete` for test index (will wait for 👍).
sophie: :thumbsup: also add a temporary pin for downstream examples. I'll open the docs PR to pin examples to `redwood-sdk==2.3.0` until verified.
maria: decision: DO NOT propagate 2.3.1 to stable. unpublish from internal test index, quarantine artifacts, and plan an emergency republish with corrected wheels (build env mismatch suspected).
jen: timeline? can we hotfix republish or do we yank+cut patch?
devon: hotfix republish preferred to preserve tracing/telemetry continuity. I'll rebuild wheel with `PY_BUILD_ENV=prod` and re-sign. ETA ~25m.
ops-bot: Canaries paused for 30m per deploy policy — automatic resume unless disabled.
kevin: after republish we'll perform local checks: `twine check dist/*`, `gpg --verify dist/*.asc`, and `sha256sum` against the release tag artifact.
maria: also add a short deprecation note for legacy sync client (v1.x) to the release notes so support teams have context. keep it minimal.
sophie: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — pins examples and adds a migration snippet for async client.
jen: plan B if republish fails: yank 2.3.1 publicly and cut 2.3.2 from main with an extra CI gate to verify signing & checksums. we'll notify #support and release-notes.
maria: ping me when twine upload completes. share the new artifact SHA256 in this thread and I'll approve repromotion. keep replies short — we'll coordinate cutover and customer comms in this thread.
